notes:
New bottom bar: the tab you are on sits in a raised circle that slides across when you switch, and Search is a plain button like the others. Profile has moved — tap your photo at the top of Home. In its place, Update checks for a new version, downloads it and installs it.

Tasks: Recurring tasks have their own page in the menu, and setting up recurring tasks or task reminders needs a permission from the Super Admin. Reminders on a new task stay closed until you tap + Add a reminder. A task you set (your own included) can be edited from its status menu until it is accepted. Tasks opens on Assigned to me, Total counts only open work, and a new button exports the list as an Excel report.

Cashbook: attach several bills to one expense — take one photo after another, or pick several at once.

Notifications: read ones clear themselves 24 hours after you open them, and Delete read removes them all at once.

Calendar: HR and Super Admin see every scheduled interview, with who is taking it.

Boys Incentive: the Rolling Team tab and the Rolling / QC rate cards; a changed rate can now also be applied to days already recorded, from a date you choose. Super Admin can switch CEO / MD approval for cash advances on or off.
